Definition: from G142 (in the sense of sending off scent); an aromatic:--(sweet) spice.
BiblicalUsage: The spices are what love brings to a grave. The women buy sweet spices to anoint Jesus, they rest on the Sabbath and return at dawn with the spices they have prepared, and Nicodemus brings myrrh and aloes to wrap the body with, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the spices are the last gift of people who thought He was dead, and that is what makes them so moving: they came to honour a body, and found an empty tomb. Love that brings spices to a grave is not wasted, because the Lord who was buried is the Lord who rose, and I hold that He remembers every gift brought in grief.
